Main flow is top-to-bottom in the center. Sub-flows peel off LEFT (Authoring) or RIGHT (Steps 3-8). Every option / classification / user choice is shown as a real branching point with its own downstream nodes — not bullets inside a label.

Verifier procedure — runs per (intent, aspect) being checked
1. Resolve focal_claimants[] + support_claimants[] for this aspect (index query)
2. Read scoped evidence — focal lines + each support's location (NOT full body)
3. Evaluate AFFIRMATIVE triple (LLM never sees negation) · runtime inverts post-verdict if polarity:negative · check quantifier cardinality · for compose:implies,
antecedent already resolved by index lookup (deterministic, no LLM)
4. Per-support-claim verdict: triple_verdict ∈ {matches | mismatch | vague} · aggregates into support_quality (advisory only, does NOT trigger re-draft)
5. Aggregate per intent's compose rule (all | any | none | implies) → per-triple {focal_verdict + support_quality} (only focal_verdict: fail triggers Engineer re-draft)
Emit failed-triple list + evidence quotes + aggregate rationale to Engineer
Engineer (bead memory persists) updates mental model · revises approach
Stuckness detector fires diagnosis EARLY (3-iter window of empty verdict_delta + stable failing-triple set) OR at iter-5 ceiling · diagnosis written to bead memory ·
consumed by BEAD ORCHESTRATOR only (never enters Verifier spawn) · iter-15 early escalation · 40-iter bead lifetime → recovery ladder: L1 partial commit / L2
intent-modification proposal / L3 freeze / L4 abort
Long-cycle regression-check sub-flow · N=10 rounds against session-snapshot universe · N=2 confirmation pass on first reject
Compute affected universe (v1) — two parallel set-computations that combine
claims modified in this bead's diff
Universe = direct ∪ adjacent (noun-phrase-shared expansion deferred to v1.x)
Round 1: sample one random unique (intent, aspect, claimant) from universe (session snapshot only — bead deltas excluded)
Spawn fresh Verifier → verdict on R1 sample · on FIRST reject: spawn N=2 confirmation Verifiers (same tuple, distinct call-ids); ≥1/2 confirm → regression, both override → flaky verdict dismissed
Round 2: sample one random unique tuple (excluding R1) · stop early if universe exhausted
Spawn fresh Verifier → verdict on R2 sample (confirmation pass only on FIRST reject in the round set)
Rounds 3..N (default N=10): sample one random unique tuple per round (stop early when universe exhausted)
Spawn fresh Verifier per round → record verdicts · accumulate until N rounds OR universe exhausted
Emit regression report (intent, aspect, claimant, failing triple)
Re-enter Step 4 short cycle with regressed intent added to active set

Test-execution sub-flow · TWO-STAGE satisfaction (NEW v9): Verifier validates test code FIRST, then Test Runner executes · Livelock detector escalates via TestVerifierLivelockReport + dusk_resolve_livelock

Pre-execution: Verifier evaluates test BODY against test-intent triples (two-stage satisfaction — only verified tests feed runtime execution) · then Spawn Test Runner (memory: bead · tools: Read + Bash[test-runner-cmd])

Query derived index → @intent-test-file claims → resolve test file paths
Query derived index → @intent-test claims → resolve individual test names within those files
Tests resolved AND Verifier-validated for each required test-intent?
(Livelock detector fires on ≥3 iters same triple + slot-focus ≥80% + ≥3 structural approaches → TestVerifierLivelockReport)

Emit 'missing or invalid tests' feedback → re-enter Step 4 to have Engineer author / fix tests · OR (if livelock detected) pause and surface TestVerifierLivelockReport for dusk_resolve_livelock(accept_test_as_is | modify_triple |
Group test files by pyramid layer (parallel per layer required by bead)
Capture pass / fail / duration per test (from runner output)
For each triple 'covers-X': ≥1 passing test annotated for aspect X?
For polarity:negative triples: affirmative claim must FAIL (runtime inversion) · For quantifier triples: matching count satisfies bound · isolation triples checked statically
Compute TestVerdict per test-intent { decision, per_triple, mapped_tests, rationale, duration }
Emit failing-tests report (test-intent, triple, file, test, result, duration)
Re-enter Step 4 with failing test-intent scope highlighted
Resolve conflicts on decorated code (git ops)

Worked decoration example — excerpt from packages/api/src/services/notifications/index.ts (RFC App. B)
The function declaration claims FIVE intents:
Inside the body, every statement is decorated:
@intent when the statement IS the focal
· the event object extracted from the publish call args
· inArray(...) predicates extracted before Drizzle chains
· Date.now() extracted to a named const
· let sent/skipped/failed collapsed to one counters obj
Verifier reads SCOPED — per aspect, not whole function:
// ["the insert chain", "uses", "Drizzle's typed insert with values and returning to write notifications atomically"]
// ["the channel resolution", "computes", "the sync channel name for the notification entity via syncChannel"]
// ["the publish loop", "iterates", "over each inserted notification to emit a sync event"]
// ["the timestamp capture", "captures", "the current epoch milliseconds for the event emission timestamp"]
// ["the event payload", "constructs", "a SyncEvent carrying the created action, the inserted notification data, and the captured timestamp"]
const event: SyncEvent<typeof notification> = { action: "created", data: notification, timestamp };
// ["the channel publish call", "delivers", "the prepared sync event onto the resolved notification channel via pubsub"]

Closing — v9 round-3 hardens the model into measurable properties. Polarity moves negation outside the LLM call. compose: implies makes conditional rules deductive (antecedents are facts, consequents are judgments). The session snapshot makes parallel reads deterministic. The recovery ladder converts thrashing into productive partial commits. The N=2 confirmation pass filters Verifier variance from regression detection. Three-axis fresh-Verifier audit makes the Engineer ⊥ Verifier asymmetry falsifiable. The diagnosis routes to the Bead Orchestrator only — the Verifier remains genuinely fresh. Build for right. Land the plane.
